name: Ketryx
description: Ketryx MCP gives your AI tools direct access to your unified compliance data. Ask a compliance question and get instant, auditable answers across your entire toolchain: Jira, JAMA, GitHub, TestRail, Polarion, and Azure DevOps.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Ketryx to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Ketryx to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.ketryx.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Ketryx MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ketryx provides these MCP tools: find_projects, find_versions, get_kql_filter_context, list_configuration_items, resolve_references, get_item_records, get_items_change_history, hybrid_search_items, and get_project_settings.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Ketryx?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Ketryx in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Ketryx requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Ketryx is developed by Ketryx. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
